title: Moreish Puff Lollies Bubblegum Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: There’s no need to chase after the ice cream van when you have Moreish Puff’s Lollies Bubblegum to vape. A sweet, sunny fruit bubblegum flavour chilled to perfection. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
